name: Hunta Rig
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 2nd unit 165 pts for 1 model; 3rd+ unit 185 pts for 1 model.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Hunta Rig model. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_transport_note: Printed as: This model has a transport capacity of 22 BEAST SNAGGAS INFANTRY models.
_loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Butcha Boyz; 1 ’Eavy Lobba; 1 Savage Horns and Hooves; 1 Saw Blades; 1 Stikka Kannon.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.
